title: polygala vulgaris var. involutiflora
intro: Polygala vulgaris var. involutiflora, commonly known as American joint-vetch or American milkwort, is a perennial plant belonging to the Polygalaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Polygala vulgaris var. involutiflora include its ability to act as an adaptogen, which can help to balance the body's response to stress, and its potential to support immune function and cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
